findings.current: I wouldn’t put a man like that under me even if he took a Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist to the head.
findings.defect: The draft makes the prospective subordinate take the blow; Jeok says he himself would still refuse even if struck in the head.
findings.rationale: The hypothetical blow is to the speaker’s head, not the other man’s.
findings.replacement: Even if I took a Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist to the head, I wouldn’t take a man like that as a subordinate.
findings.source: 대가리에 멸염신권을 맞아도 그런 놈은 수하로 안 부린다.

findings.current: “Then I’ll search you from head to toe. Ten hits for every syllable I find. Still nothing?”
findings.defect: Jeok threatens punishment for any story that turns up later, not for syllables found by physically searching Ma.
findings.rationale: The threat concerns withheld information, continuing Jeok’s demand that Ma tell him more.
findings.replacement: “If I dig around and anything comes out later, it’s ten hits per syllable. Still nothing?”
findings.source: 지금부터 뒤져서 나오면 한 음절에 열 대다. 이래도 없느냐?

findings.current: Even if he had more to tell, he’d just grit his teeth and take it.
findings.defect: The draft says Ma would take the beating; Jin says he would hold out even at the risk of death.
findings.rationale: 죽을 각오로 버티지 describes resisting with a willingness to die, not submitting to punishment.
findings.replacement: Even if he had more to tell, he’d hold out even if it killed him.
findings.source: 설령 남은 이야기가 있더라도 죽을 각오로 버티지.

findings.current: Ma Junggeol and his sworn brothers jumped to the wrong conclusion right away.
findings.defect: The draft substitutes an unsupported mistaken conclusion for their immediate fear.
findings.rationale: The source describes them getting scared in advance; it does not say what they concluded.
findings.replacement: Ma Junggeol and his sworn brothers were already frightened before I’d said a word.
findings.source: 지레 겁부터 집어먹는 마중걸과 그의 의형제들.

findings.current: No—they don’t even have the guts to lie.
findings.defect: This changes Jeok’s assessment from lack of capability to lack of courage.
findings.rationale: 깜냥조차 없어 questions whether they have it in them to deceive, not merely whether they dare.
findings.replacement: No—they aren’t even capable of it.

findings.defect: “Chief” replaces the sworn brothers’ senior-brother address.
findings.rationale: 대형 identifies Ma by his place among the brothers rather than by his office.
findings.replacement: “What our eldest brother said is righ—”

findings.current: With the air of some random beggar.
findings.defect: The draft loses the numbered-background-character joke.
findings.rationale: 거지1 presents him as an anonymous, numbered bit part.

summary: Several lines alter who takes a blow, the threatened penalty, or the brothers’ reactions. A few smaller choices lose kinship and comic nuance.
